facts.text: The assessee is the firm of Messrs. Ashok Leyland Ltd., Ennore, with factory at Ennore in the State of Madras.

anchor.surface_text: The firm of Messrs. Ashok Leyland Ltd., Ennore, is the appellant before us. For brevity and companyvenience, we shall hereinafter refer to the firm as the assessee.

facts.text: The assessee manufactures, assembles and sells motor vehicles and spare parts and accessories thereof through an organisation spread over several States.

anchor.surface_text: The assessee is a firm with its factory at Ennore in the State of Madras, where it manufactures, assembles and sells motor vehicles and spare parts and accessories thereof, through an elaborate organisation spread over several States.

facts.text: The assessee appoints distributors called dealers with definite territorial jurisdiction inside and outside Madras, granting sole selling rights within allotted territory.

anchor.surface_text: The system of distribution of its motor vehicles, spare parts and accessories at one uniform price to companysumers in the various States which the assessee adopted, companysisted of the appointment of a distributor  called a dealer  with a definite territorial jurisdiction, both inside and outside the State of Madras To every such dealer it granted the sole right of selling the products of the firm within the territory allotted to him.

facts.text: For dealers outside Madras, products are delivered by consignment by rail, steamer or road transport.

anchor.surface_text: If the territory of the dealer was outside the State of Madras, the agreement entered into by the dealer provided for the delivery of the products of the firm by companysignment, by rail or steamer or road transport.

facts.text: Dealers must not canvass or sell outside allotted territory; breach allows termination and return of unsold products.

anchor.surface_text: The agreement specifically stipulated that the dealer must number canvass or sell the products outside the territory allotted to him, and in the event of infringement or breach of the undertaking by the dealer, the assessee was entitled to terminate the agreement forthwith. On such termination, the assessee reserved the right to call upon the dealer to return all or any of the products remaining unsold at the date of such termination.

anchor.surface_text: First of all, sub-s. (2) of new s. 22 makes it quite clear that the section does not affect the liability to tax of any sale or purchase under any other provision of the Act.
